findings.title: Docstring update lacks a period
findings.body: The new docstring on line 1 changes the module description but omits a terminal period, breaking the local convention of ending docstrings with punctuation.

findings.title: Missing timezone validation in existing callers
findings.body: `book_slot` now enforces timezone-aware `start`, but the module's own usage on line 14 (`start + timedelta(minutes=minutes)`) does not guarantee `start` is timezone-aware. Existing callers may pass naive datetimes, causing silent incorrect behavior. Either make `start` validation mandatory at the module boundary or document the requirement and update all callers.

summary.problem: A docstring update lacks punctuation and a new function adds a correctness risk by assuming timezone-aware inputs without enforcing them at the module boundary.
summary.done_well: The docstring now clarifies the unit of route lengths, and the function validates positive minutes as before.
